violation_type.title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(4)(B))
violation_type.short_title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured
violation_type.typical_finding: 1 child under 4'9" was not transported in a booster seat.

finding_variants.text: 1 child under 4'9" was not transported in a booster seat.
The transportation van only had 1 booster seat and they transported 7 Kinder children.

During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the van used to transport 5 children, four of them between the ages of 4-6 years old, was not equipt with any booster seats or forward facing child safety seat.
